messages:
maya: FYI we started seeing a sustained increase in 5xx/timeouts for hosted inference in eu-west-1 ~10m ago. Multiple customer tickets (e.g., #3456) reporting timeouts + intermittent billing failures. p50 fine, p95 ~12s, error rate ~18% for /v1/generate. @raj @ben can you triage?

raj: Jumping in. I see a spike in gateway 504s and a matching rise in auth-proxy 502s. Quick look at edge logs shows repeated upstream_read_timeout to inference-runtime pools. Appears correlated with a surge from a small set of API keys.

support-bot: New support ticket linked: #3456, #3460. Customers report: "requests hang, then 504" and "charged for failed requests".

ben: I can confirm auth-proxy is returning 502s when backend takes >8s. Health checks are mangled: kube shows restarts for auth-proxy pod group auth-proxy-eu-1 (OOM not seen).

lina: Repro steps from one of the tickets (sanitized):
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"input":"long context causing GPU mem pressure..."}'
```
Response: 504 gateway timeout after ~10s.

raj: Running the same locally against eu-west-1 with a small synthetic load. I can reproduce ~20% 5xx at ~120 rps. Kernel trace shows some inference pods hitting high GC/CPU wait and long scheduling delays. Suspect batching + long-tail requests causing KV cache thrash.

maya: Can we fallback to a cheaper, lower-latency model variant for affected customers temporarily? We need immediate mitigation to reduce customer impact.

oliver: I'll flip routing policy to prefer model-2-128 (smaller) for non-verified customers. Doing a staged routing change now (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%).

sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1145. Priority: P1. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-inference-5xx

ben: Rolling restart of auth-proxy eu-west-1 in progress (kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy -n prod-eu). Observability: adding additional request timeouts at the edge to fail fast (reduce double-dipping).

raj: Also scaling inference pool +3 GPUs (autoscaling override) to absorb current load. Monitoring padding for 10m.

lina: Collected snippets from runtime logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:07Z] inference-runtime.eu-west-1 ERROR request_id=abc123 UpstreamError: write timeout to gpu-12: upstream_read_timeout
[2026-03-15T10:12:09Z] auth-proxy ERROR token_validation timed out after 7.9s for key abcd-****
```
(removed PII)

maya: Quick customer communication drafted (s/support@/ops@): "We're investigating elevated 5xx/timeout errors in eu-west-1 and have enacted temporary routing and capacity increases. No long-term billing charges will be applied for failed requests; support will follow up." Approving send.

support-bot: Customer messages queued, sent to owners.

raj: After restart and scaling we're seeing error rate drop to ~4% and p95 down to ~3.2s. Canary routing to model-2-128 reduced exposure. Keeping watch for 30m.

oliver: Rolling back canary to 0% for verified customers, keeping fallback for free-tier until mitigation done.

lina: Action items to capture for post-incident follow-up:
- lina: add a runbook step for "KV cache eviction when long context requests present" (PR by 2026-03-20).
- raj: investigate batching backpressure and add a circuit-breaker for slow requests (RFC by 2026-03-22).
- ben: add healthcheck refinement and fail-fast config for auth-proxy (deploy by 2026-03-18).
- oliver: billing follow-up to verify no charged failed requests and draft customer credits (by 2026-03-19).
- maya: postmortem writeup & timeline (draft by 2026-03-17).

maya: Agree on ownership. I'll create INC-2026-1145 doc and schedule a 1hr retrospective tomorrow.

sre-bot: Incident marked mitigated at 1956004534. Summary: temporary routing + scale + auth-proxy restart reduced errors. Follow-ups assigned.

ben: Added quick dashboard panels to show per-model 5xx and auth-proxy latency. Link: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/hosted-inference/eu-west-1-5xx

raj: Notes for RCA: initial root cause hypothesis = long-tail request shapes + batching causing increased KV cache churn and transient overload of inference containers which then surfaced through auth-proxy timeouts. Need more traces to prove.

oliver: I'll coordinate billing reconciliation. If anyone sees a regression re-open the thread.

maya: Thanks team. Closing active triage, moving to follow-up lane.
